adaptations: Actual DLL WSInfoPanel.Update, OnGeneralInfoUpdate, OnTimeLeftUpdate, OnSwordStateUpdate, ResetSwordValue, WarSceneController.SetIsSwordFull/IsSwordFull, GeneralController.GetState/IsCanReleaseMagic and MagicController.OnGeneralSetMagic/OnMagicOver bytecode is retained. Unity Time.deltaTime is supplied by the test. Actual original ex2D clipping width getter/setter bytecode is retained on uninitialized boundary fixtures; exPlane updateFlags rendering dispatch is a no-op. Sprite color and font text setters are no-op render boundaries; GeneralController.SetOnMagic's native animation is a no-op. Resource loading, prefab instantiate/destroy and gray overlay rendering are stubbed. Original MagicConfig XML parsing is retained. No Android renderer or scene/touch behavior is claimed.

Actual DLL CombatRules and AutoBattleMath bytecode, including the private CreateState and complete Simulate methods, is retained unchanged. The long-life, high-MP simulation fixtures isolate charging opportunities and MP conservation; they do not represent normal gameplay balance.

The hand-battle opportunity test executes 990 real Update calls at 0.1 seconds each. Its fixture countdown begins at 1000 so native scene/time-up handling is not invoked. Real skill permission, bar reset and MP deductions execute; native animation duration, skill effects, Android scene and GPU drawing are not simulated. Manual-versus-auto timing tolerances account for float/frame quantization and the established manual one-pixel charge floor.
